events.continuity_hook: Carry the strongest Portland and midcoast pairings, complete seven-night totals, occupancy details, and transfer-day drive times into the date and airport decision.
events.interaction_goal: Identify two viable split-stay combinations and determine which coastal town offers the best balance of lodging practicality and access for the family.
events.scenario_brief: Marcus, his husband, and their son are leaning toward dividing the seven nights between Portland and Maine's midcoast rather than driving back and forth from one base. They need two-night Portland options and five-night options in Camden, Rockland, and Boothbay Harbor compared for three-person occupancy, room configuration, taxes, parking, cancellation deadlines, and drive time on the transfer day.

events.continuity_hook: Retain the selected seven-night date pattern, arrival airport, lodging pair, rental window, and full trip estimate for final availability checks.
events.interaction_goal: Resolve the date and airport tradeoff and choose one flight, car, and split-stay structure without purchasing yet.
events.scenario_brief: The preferred Camden lodging has availability only for a Sunday-to-Friday coastal stay, while the best Rockland alternative works with the original Saturday-to-Saturday week. Marcus now needs the two complete date patterns compared using current flights into Portland and Boston, rental-car duration, hotel totals, parking, transfer-day timing, and the usable portion of the first and last vacation days.

events.continuity_hook: Keep the completed flight, car, Portland hotel, and Camden lodging reservations together with final totals, payment timing, and cancellation deadlines.
events.interaction_goal: Recheck availability and end-to-end timing, then complete all four reservations at the current totals.
events.scenario_brief: The family has chosen the Sunday-to-Sunday itinerary through Portland, with two nights in Portland and five nights in Camden. Marcus needs the three round-trip tickets, airport rental car, both lodging stays, parking charges, and the Tuesday transfer checked as one itinerary, including pickup and return hours and each property's cancellation deadline.

events.continuity_hook: Leave the family with a confirmed five-night Camden room that explicitly accommodates three people, and retain any price difference and the new cancellation deadline.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the valid replacement rooms by full stay cost, parking, location, and sleeping setup, then modify or replace the Camden reservation before the deadline.
events.scenario_brief: The Camden property has clarified that the reserved room contains one queen bed and cannot accommodate a third guest, despite the original search showing occupancy for three. A two-queen room at the same property and two nearby alternatives are available, and the current booking remains cancellable for several more days.

events.continuity_hook: Keep the final reservation details, arrival instructions, rental pickup plan, Sunday drive allowance, parking costs, and contact information assembled for the trip.
events.interaction_goal: Confirm that every reservation reflects three travelers and establish workable arrival and departure timing without making new purchases unless a discrepancy appears.
events.scenario_brief: The Maine departure is approaching, and Marcus wants the altered Camden room checked alongside the Portland hotel, flights, and rental car. The outbound arrives in Portland late enough that the rental counter's closing time and hotel check-in window matter, while the return requires driving from Camden to the airport on a summer Sunday.

events.continuity_hook: Carry one feasible same-day flight pair and one Sunday-night fallback, including airport ground timing, into a lodging and total-cost decision.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the same-day and overnight flight structures using realistic door-to-door timing and current round-trip costs, without booking until the restaurant confirms the start time.
events.scenario_brief: Marcus has a Monday restaurant visit in Pittsburgh scheduled from 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. He would prefer to determine whether nonstop flights from Chicago make a same-day trip realistic, but a Sunday-evening outbound remains possible if the morning airport-to-restaurant timing is too tight; the Monday return must leave enough time after the visit for the drive and security.
